verdict.rationale: WezTerm is configured with a real programming language: its config is a `.wezterm.lua` Lua file with per-window overrides and live reload. Users report adding keybindings in Lua and treating the config as diffable code. Shell-integration user vars can also drive tab titles and the status area, but the evidence shows Lua configuration rather than a documented plugin system or scripting API that goes beyond built-in options. missing for 10: documented plugin/extension mechanism, event-hook or scripting API reference showing behavior beyond built-in options, hands-on examples of custom scripted extensions.
